title: Deterministic Canonical Decode
negative_results: a bad-checksum vector yields an explicit INVALID result (REFUSAL claim), never a guess
a malformed or legacy nine-digit string decodes to INVALID, never an alias set
require_point raises on an invalid decode
refuse_alias_for_canonical always raises: a canonical vector never yields aliases
a GeographicPoint without a CRS and epoch is refused (invariant 9)

claims.statement: A canonical CW-GEO-1 vector decodes deterministically to exactly one GeographicPoint carrying its CRS (frame) and epoch (POWER round-trip).
A checksum failure, version mismatch, or malformed payload yields an explicit INVALID result; a canonical vector never yields an alias set.
